text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've sent Dana the list in her DM. Moss wrote six notes in total, and two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers turned up in them:

1. #4419: gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 for scanner firmware testing. Source: Moss's undated North cheat sheet (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md).
2. #PD-4492: logged by Thea Ramaswell on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers at Eau Claire Doors 14–18 weren't getting SMS bay assignments at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it the same evening, and Thea confirmed the next morning's shift went through fine. Source: Moss's 5 Oct 2025 Sunday prep note (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md).

The other four notes have no Quarrendon ticket numbers. The tickets in the Central notes (#4409, #4412 and FR-882) belong to Marrow accounts, not Quarrendon.

I also told her two other things:
- The cheat sheet warns not to confuse Quarrendon Freight Lines with Quarendon Freightways, which isn't a customer.
- Her own 9 Apr 2026 renewal debrief mentions a third ticket, #8841 (carrier portal timeout on large CSV uploads). It's not from Moss, so she can leave it out of the weekly notes if she only wants Moss's sources.

Every source I used is a public file or her own notes. Nothing needed approval.
